⛔ Disclosure (#9387, `5323310017`): abstract, by class only.

The notification half of ruling `6335348115` (#25082 → PR #25258) re-derived its own placement table from the notification renderer's encoder. In doing so it modelled two classes of HTML tree-builder behaviour that may be under-modelled in this card's placement reading (PR #25212); offered for the spec lane to check, not asserted as a defect:

1. **Where foreign content (SVG / MathML) ends.** The notification half treats foreign content as never left once entered, and refuses every hole after its root.
2. **Text-element start tags the tree builder may ignore.** In some insertion modes the tokenizer and the tree builder disagree on whether a raw-text or escapable-text element actually opens; the notification half forks the reading there and requires every reading to be safe.

PR #25258's `packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-hole-placement.ts` and its tests show the shape this lane took. Any concrete reading belongs in a private channel per the disclosure ruling.
